[[Chaos Damage]] | skill = | aura = | metadata_id = Metadata/Monsters/Doedre/DoedreSoul }} '''Doedre, Darksoul''' is a [[List of unique monsters|unique monster]] located in [[The Rotting Core]] in [[Act 9]]. She is the Spirit form of [[Doedre Stamatis|Doedre]]. This is the last time she is fought during the storyline, if not counting [[The Depraved Trinity]] encounter. ==Quests== * {{ql|Recurring Nightmare}} ==Abilities== She casts projectile spells in both of her forms which deal physical damage. She can also use an arena-wide screech spell which can be avoided by standing behind Accursed Monoliths. The Accursed Monoliths in the boss room will cast 3 different debuffs: {| class= "wikitable" |- ! Debuff name ! Colour ! Description |- | Doedre's Torment | Red | You are taking 6% increased damage for each stack of Doedre's Torment. |- | Doedre's Withering | Green | You and your Minions are dealing 5% less damage for each stack of Doedre's Withering. |- |Doedre's Suffering |Purple | Your action speed is 5% slower for each stack of Doedre's Suffering. |- |} The debuffs are alternative versions of {{stl|Temporal Chains}}, {{stl|Enfeeble}} and {{stl|Vulnerability}}, as well as [[Effluent]] debuffs. Destroying monoliths will remove corresponding debuffs. Note that [[Doedre's Torment (monster)|Doedre's Torment]] and [[Doedre's Suffering (monster)|Doedre's Suffering]] are also the names of the monsters found in Doedre's Despair subarea of [[The Rotting Core]]. {{clear}} {{status | name = Doedre's Torment | type = Debuff }} {{status | name = Doedre's Withering | type = Debuff }} {{status | name = Doedre's Suffering | type = Debuff }} ====Video==== {{#ev:youtube|BZDlS7E_A_c|||||start=131}} {{Monster item drops|metadata_id=Metadata/Monsters/Doedre/DoedreSoul}} ==Map variant== * [[Doedre the Defiler]], map boss of {{il|Sepulchre Map}} ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.0.0| * Introduced to the game. }} {{Version history table end}} {{Navbox Bestiary}} [[Category:Bosses]] [[Category:Act 9 unique monsters]]
